items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: Jerry Goldsmith, who passed away a few years ago, who studied with Bernard Herrmann, he’s one of my favorite scorers.

ctx.x: Yeah, they said it can’t be better than that. We can’t get anybody to — so I think Bernard Herrmann is my favorite; and Jerry Goldsmith, who passed away a few years ago, who studied with Bernard Herrmann, he’s one of my favorite scorers. So those three come to mind right away. And then there’s Korngold of course, from the older school.
